name: Polis Massa
description: Polis Massa was a planetoid in a dense asteroid field located in the Subterrel sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, far from any major hyperspace lanes. At some point, Polis Massa was a planet located within the system of the same name. The planet was home to a subterranean people called the Eellayin until it was destroyed. But the rocky fragments of the planet still held relics of the Eelayin, which were collected and studied by Kallidahin archaeologists.
